steps.title: Gemma hears the diner
steps.reasoning: One call transcribes the audio and extracts the request. The model resolves 'without the fish sauce' against the dish it just heard named.

result.utterance: Je suis allergique au poisson. Vous pouvez faire le pad thai sans nuoc-mam ?

steps.title: The dish table decides what can come out
steps.reasoning: Whether an ingredient is structural is data, not generation. A 5B model guessing at culinary structure is exactly what this avoids.

blocking.why: Fish sauce is the salt and the backbone of pad thai. Without it the dish has no seasoning base — it is not a garnish that can be left off.

steps.title: SerpApi — what the manufacturer declares
steps.reasoning: 'fish sauce' arrives in a jar. What is actually in it is the manufacturer's declaration, not our table.

result.unavailable: SERPAPI_KEY is not set and this query is not cached. Put the key in a .env file — see .env.example.

steps.title: Refuse rather than guess
steps.reasoning: The blocking ingredient is what makes the dish that dish. The honest answer is no — and saying so is more useful than a modification the kitchen would have to refuse at the pass.

steps.title: Gemma explains it in the diner's language (fr)
steps.reasoning: The verdict was fixed before this ran. Gemma's job is to say it clearly and give the reason, not to reach it.

explanation: Nous ne pouvons pas servir ceci comme demandé. La sauce de poisson est le sel et l'épine dorsale du pad thaï. Sans elle, le plat n'a aucune base d'assaisonnement — ce n'est pas un garnissage qui peut être omis. La sauce de poisson ne peut pas être laissée de côté, donc ce plat n'est pas possible pour vous. Nous pouvons suggérer autre chose du menu.
explanation_en: We cannot serve this as requested. Fish sauce is the salt and the backbone of pad thai. Without it the dish has no seasoning base — it is not a garnish that can be left off. The fish sauce cannot be left out, so this dish is not possible for you. We can suggest something else from the menu.
